decisions.decision: The platform does not restrict outbound traffic from app containers. Where blocking is needed, the network or host firewall does it.
decisions.basis: Allowing container egress is the usual default. The platform's own boundary does not depend on it.
observed: sudo ss -ltnp on the development host: the Core listeners (miy-server) are 127.0.0.1:18180/18182/18183/18184, the PostgreSQL publish is 127.0.0.1:15432 and every app container publishes on 127.0.0.1 only.
A disposable container on the default Docker bridge connected to the gateway address: ports 443, 8000 and 9090 accepted, 18180 and 15432 refused. ufw is inactive and INPUT is ACCEPT.
decisions.consequence: No platform code change. A perimeter firewall does not see traffic from a container to other services on the same host, so SERVER-OPERATIONS names a dedicated host or a host firewall rule as an installation condition. The development host has neither and runs unrelated services on all addresses; accepted for the development server.

decisions.decision: A server deployment accepts only the output of a server build. A local build is for local testing.
decisions.basis: The server build takes committed source only, on a fixed recipe with locked dependencies and no network during the build, and runs cargo fmt --check, cargo test, pnpm typecheck, the SDK/component integrity checks and the migration history check. A locally built image carried none of that.
decisions.consequence: Implemented below as CLI/bundle 0.11.0. It does not run clippy or frontend tests; that is unchanged.

changes.change: runtime::server_built: an image is deployable only when a succeeded app_builds row of the same app produced it. Checked in the plan (runtime_preflight: a failed image check with server_build_required), at submission (409 server_build_required for deploy and for promote, after authorization) and by the worker before it inspects the image (a job queued by an earlier server fails with server_build_required). Another app's build of the same image does not count. A retry passes through the same submission.

Removed POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/images, GET /api/v1/image-uploads/{id}, GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/image-uploads/by-request/{request}, the worker's archive import tick, the archive verifier and the original-to-local image mapping, the capability images.idempotency.v1, the delegation action upload and the failure codes image_import_failed, archive_hash_mismatch and upload_expired. A deployment runs the image under its own ID.

miy app build always builds on the selected server; --remote, --platform and the local release image build are gone, and no client needs Docker, Rust or pnpm to build or deploy. miy app deploy requires the project's server build receipt and otherwise ends before any request with server_build_required and the recovery command miy app build. A plan that fails for this reason (typically promoting a release whose image an earlier CLI uploaded) reports the same code and recovery. The image export and upload client is deleted.

A record written by an earlier CLI still loads: its upload key is read and never written. A deployment record must name the server build of its image; one that uploaded a local image is refused on resume with local_image_deployment_removed and the recovery command miy app build.

CLI and bundle 0.11.0. crates/miy/bundles/0.10.0.json records the published 0.10.0 protected files from 9133d70 (the same rule applied to 173c6d5 reproduces the committed 0.9.0 record byte for byte). miy app upgrade moves a 0.10.0 project to 0.11.0; only guidance files differ (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/CONTRACT.md, docs/CLI.md and the app skill). UI 1.1.0, published for bundle 0.10.0, is accepted by 0.11.0.

The runtime regression records its runner-built images as the app's succeeded server builds and adds two observations: an image without that record is refused in the plan, at submission and by the worker; an accepted release of such an image cannot be promoted. The archive import observation and the image upload recovery observation are removed (runtime 47, operations 5, 131 in total). check-cli-recovery.py now drives deployments from a synthetic server build receipt, with Docker on PATH only to prove it is never called. check-cli-output.py checks that build and deploy need no local tools. check-pilot-flow.mjs has no local build option.

PLAN (decisions 8 and 9, the completed row, the pending 0.11.0 row, the Docker 28 export observation no longer applies to this candidate), APP-BOUNDARIES findings 17 and 18, CORE-PERMISSIONS (execution target rule, upload action removed), SERVER-OPERATIONS (app container network conditions, the unreleased candidate and what it changes for existing installations), RUNNING, DEVELOPMENT, CHECKS, CLI-RELEASE.
